title: Review of lab 1's ad5-evolve (IDH): on fresh seeds 7 and 8 the planted ancestral droplets never divide, and only droplets carrying a mutant allele divide and breed true (5-6 persistent splits, generation 2-3, 0 merges); deaths are only imposed dilution, and the H gate control was not run
summary: First labkit packs of threads/active-droplets/worlds/ad5-evolve/world.py on fresh seeds 7 and 8 (128^2, t=20000). Six planted allele-0 droplets (lavender) grow to a fixed size and do not divide in 20000 t. On seed 8 a mutation patch makes a faster-allele droplet (cyan) at t~6100; it divides at t~6900 and its descendants divide again (dumbbells at t=7900, 12100, 13100, 14800, 16500), every daughter cyan, until cyan droplets outnumber the ancestors 9 to 4 (pack8/sheet.png); a second mutant kind (green) appears at t~15600. labkit: seed 7, 5 splits, 5 persistent, generation 2, 0 merges, 10 bodies at the end; seed 8, 7 splits, 6 persistent, generation 3, 0 merges, 12 bodies.

observations.I: pack8/sheet.png: discrete droplets at bounded size throughout
observations.D: pack8/lineage.png: 6 persistent splits, generation 3 after the planted founders, 0 merges; the dividing lineage is the mutant cyan kind (pack8/sheet.png t=6900-16500)

seeds_run.result: D to generation 2 only (below the 3 needed from planted founders)
D to generation 3 by mutant droplets; ancestors never divide

verdicts.limitation: Founders are planted (not S). Division happens only in droplets with a faster allele, so reproduction is tied to the trait under selection; the spread of the mutant is a colonization race with no intrinsic deaths (dilution disks are imposed), and the mutation is an imposed patch transplant, as lab 1 noted. H needs the neutral gate control, which I did not run.
